description.en: The name of the OSS bucket.

description.zh:
是否总是上传处理后的图片。

若为fasle，只有在命中脱敏规则后才上传。

若为true，则总会上传处理后的图片。
description.en:
Specifies whether to always upload the processed image.

If you set this to false, the image is uploaded only if it matches a masking rule.

If you set this to true, the processed image is always uploaded.
Specifies whether you can restore the original image from the masked version.

description.zh:
脱敏规则ID列表，用,分隔符进行连接。

规则ID映射关系如下

3000 包含身份证信息的图片（中国内地）

3009 包含车牌信息的图片（中国内地）

3002 包含人脸信息的图片

1002 姓名（简体中文）

1003 地址（中国内地）

4003 统一社会信用代码

63009 包含人脸眼部信息的图片
description.en:
A comma-separated list of masking rule IDs.

The following rule IDs correspond to the listed sensitive data types:

3000: Images that contain ID card information (Chinese mainland)

3009: Images that contain license plate information (Chinese mainland)

3002: Images that contain faces

1002: Names (Simplified Chinese)

1003: Addresses (Chinese mainland)

4003: Unified Social Credit Code

63009: Images that contain eyes

description.zh: 文件在OSS上存储的完整文件名。
description.en: The full key of the object stored in OSS.
The region where the bucket is located.

descriptions.zh:
**前置条件**

需要购买图片脱敏额度才可以使用接口，每调用一次接口，会扣减一次对应的脱敏额度。

**QPS 限制**

本接口的单用户 QPS 限制为 10 次/秒。超过限制，API 调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。

**使用说明**

脱敏完成后，图片会存储到图片所属Bucket下的aliyun_dsc_desensitization文件夹中。

例如，Bucket中的图片exampledir/test.png，脱敏后会存储为aliyun_dsc_desensitization/exampledir/test.png。

详情可见https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dsc/data-security-center/user-guide/picture-desensitization
descriptions.en:
**Prerequisites**

To use this operation, you must have an image masking quota. Each call deducts one unit from your quota.

**QPS limit**

The QPS limit for a single user is 10. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which can affect your business. To prevent service disruptions, operate within this limit.

**Usage notes**

After masking is complete, the system stores the masked image in the aliyun\_dsc\_desensitization folder within the source bucket.

For example, an image at exampledir/test.png in a bucket is saved as aliyun\_dsc\_desensitization/exampledir/test.png after masking.

For more information, see https\://help.aliyun.com/zh/dsc/data-security-center/user-guide/picture-desensitization

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sddp mask-oss-image --bucket-name sddp-api-demo-bucket --object-key dir1/test.png --service-region-id cn-hangzhou --mask-rule-id-list 3000,3002 --is-support-restore true --is-always-upload true --is-cover-object true --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sddp MaskOssImage --region cn-hangzhou --BucketName 'sddp-api-demo-bucket' --ServiceRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --MaskRuleIdList '3000,3002' --IsCoverObject true --ObjectKey 'dir1/test.png' --Lang zh --IsAlwaysUpload true --IsSupportRestore true
